BULBASAUR.name: Bulbasaur
BULBASAUR.dexEntry: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this POKéMON is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

IVYSAUR.name: Ivysaur
IVYSAUR.dexEntry: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

VENUSAUR.name: Venusaur
VENUSAUR.dexEntry: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

CHARMANDER.name: Charmander
CHARMANDER.dexEntry: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

CHARMELEON.name: Charmeleon
CHARMELEON.dexEntry: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

CHARIZARD.name: Charizard
CHARIZARD.dexEntry: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

SQUIRTLE.name: Squirtle
SQUIRTLE.dexEntry: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

WARTORTLE.name: Wartortle
WARTORTLE.dexEntry: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.

BLASTOISE.name: Blastoise
BLASTOISE.dexEntry: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

CATERPIE.name: Caterpie
CATERPIE.dexEntry: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

METAPOD.name: Metapod
METAPOD.dexEntry: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

BUTTERFREE.name: Butterfree
BUTTERFREE.dexEntry: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly about even in rain.

WEEDLE.name: Weedle
WEEDLE.dexEntry: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

KAKUNA.name: Kakuna
KAKUNA.dexEntry: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

BEEDRILL.name: Beedrill
BEEDRILL.dexEntry: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

PIDGEY.name: Pidgey
PIDGEY.dexEntry: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.

PIDGEOTTO.name: Pidgeotto
PIDGEOTTO.dexEntry: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.

PIDGEOT.name: Pidgeot
PIDGEOT.dexEntry: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

RATTATA.name: Rattata
RATTATA.dexEntry: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

RATICATE.name: Raticate
RATICATE.dexEntry: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

SPEAROW.name: Spearow
SPEAROW.dexEntry: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.

FEAROW.name: Fearow
FEAROW.dexEntry: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.

EKANS.name: Ekans
EKANS.dexEntry: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

ARBOK.name: Arbok
ARBOK.dexEntry: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

PIKACHU.name: Pikachu
PIKACHU.dexEntry: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

RAICHU.name: Raichu
RAICHU.dexEntry: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

SANDSHREW.name: Sandshrew
SANDSHREW.dexEntry: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

SANDSLASH.name: Sandslash
SANDSLASH.dexEntry: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

NIDORAN_F.name: Nidoran♀
NIDORAN_F.dexEntry: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.

NIDORINA.name: Nidorina
NIDORINA.dexEntry: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

NIDOQUEEN.name: Nidoqueen
NIDOQUEEN.dexEntry: The body is covered by stiff, needle- like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

NIDORAN_M.name: Nidoran♂
NIDORAN_M.dexEntry: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

NIDORINO.name: Nidorino
NIDORINO.dexEntry: It is easily angered. By swinging its well- developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

NIDOKING.name: Nidoking
NIDOKING.dexEntry: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

CLEFAIRY.name: Clefairy
CLEFAIRY.dexEntry: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

CLEFABLE.name: Clefable
CLEFABLE.dexEntry: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

VULPIX.name: Vulpix
VULPIX.dexEntry: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

NINETALES.name: Ninetales
NINETALES.dexEntry: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

JIGGLYPUFF.name: Jigglypuff
JIGGLYPUFF.dexEntry: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

WIGGLYTUFF.name: Wigglytuff
WIGGLYTUFF.dexEntry: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.

ZUBAT.name: Zubat
ZUBAT.dexEntry: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.

GOLBAT.name: Golbat
GOLBAT.dexEntry: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.

ODDISH.name: Oddish
ODDISH.dexEntry: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

GLOOM.name: Gloom
GLOOM.dexEntry: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

VILEPLUME.name: Vileplume
VILEPLUME.dexEntry: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.

PARAS.name: Paras
PARAS.dexEntry: Growing out of the bug's back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

PARASECT.name: Parasect
PARASECT.dexEntry: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.

VENONAT.name: Venonat
VENONAT.dexEntry: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.

VENOMOTH.name: Venomoth
VENOMOTH.dexEntry: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

DIGLETT.name: Diglett
DIGLETT.dexEntry: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

DUGTRIO.name: Dugtrio
DUGTRIO.dexEntry: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

MEOWTH.name: Meowth
MEOWTH.dexEntry: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

PERSIAN.name: Persian
PERSIAN.dexEntry: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.

PSYDUCK.name: Psyduck
PSYDUCK.dexEntry: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

GOLDUCK.name: Golduck
GOLDUCK.dexEntry: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

MANKEY.name: Mankey
MANKEY.dexEntry: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.

PRIMEAPE.name: Primeape
PRIMEAPE.dexEntry: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

GROWLITHE.name: Growlithe
GROWLITHE.dexEntry: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

ARCANINE.name: Arcanine
ARCANINE.dexEntry: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

POLIWAG.name: Poliwag
POLIWAG.dexEntry: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

POLIWHIRL.name: Poliwhirl
POLIWHIRL.dexEntry: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

POLIWRATH.name: Poliwrath
POLIWRATH.dexEntry: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

ABRA.name: Abra
ABRA.dexEntry: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.

KADABRA.name: Kadabra
KADABRA.dexEntry: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.

ALAKAZAM.name: Alakazam
ALAKAZAM.dexEntry: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extra- sensory powers to defeat foes.

MACHOP.name: Machop
MACHOP.dexEntry: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

MACHOKE.name: Machoke
MACHOKE.dexEntry: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

MACHAMP.name: Machamp
MACHAMP.dexEntry: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

BELLSPROUT.name: Bellsprout
BELLSPROUT.dexEntry: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

WEEPINBELL.name: Weepinbell
WEEPINBELL.dexEntry: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

VICTREEBEL.name: Victreebel
VICTREEBEL.dexEntry: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.

TENTACOOL.name: Tentacool
TENTACOOL.dexEntry: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.

TENTACRUEL.name: Tentacruel
TENTACRUEL.dexEntry: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

GEODUDE.name: Geodude
GEODUDE.dexEntry: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.

GRAVELER.name: Graveler
GRAVELER.dexEntry: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.

GOLEM.name: Golem
GOLEM.dexEntry: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

PONYTA.name: Ponyta
PONYTA.dexEntry: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

RAPIDASH.name: Rapidash
RAPIDASH.dexEntry: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.

SLOWPOKE.name: Slowpoke
SLOWPOKE.dexEntry: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

SLOWBRO.name: Slowbro
SLOWBRO.dexEntry: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.

MAGNEMITE.name: Magnemite
MAGNEMITE.dexEntry: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.

MAGNETON.name: Magneton
MAGNETON.dexEntry: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

FARFETCHD.name: Farfetch'd
FARFETCHD.dexEntry: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

DODUO.name: Doduo
DODUO.dexEntry: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

DODRIO.name: Dodrio
DODRIO.dexEntry: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

SEEL.name: Seel
SEEL.dexEntry: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.

DEWGONG.name: Dewgong
DEWGONG.dexEntry: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

GRIMER.name: Grimer
GRIMER.dexEntry: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.

MUK.name: Muk
MUK.dexEntry: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.

SHELLDER.name: Shellder
SHELLDER.dexEntry: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

CLOYSTER.name: Cloyster
CLOYSTER.dexEntry: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

GASTLY.name: Gastly
GASTLY.dexEntry: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

HAUNTER.name: Haunter
HAUNTER.dexEntry: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.

GENGAR.name: Gengar
GENGAR.dexEntry: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

ONIX.name: Onix
ONIX.dexEntry: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

DROWZEE.name: Drowzee
DROWZEE.dexEntry: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

HYPNO.name: Hypno
HYPNO.dexEntry: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

KRABBY.name: Krabby
KRABBY.dexEntry: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

KINGLER.name: Kingler
KINGLER.dexEntry: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

VOLTORB.name: Voltorb
VOLTORB.dexEntry: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.

ELECTRODE.name: Electrode
ELECTRODE.dexEntry: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”

EXEGGCUTE.name: Exeggcute
EXEGGCUTE.dexEntry: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.

EXEGGUTOR.name: Exeggutor
EXEGGUTOR.dexEntry: It is called “The Walking Tropical Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

CUBONE.name: Cubone
CUBONE.dexEntry: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.

MAROWAK.name: Marowak
MAROWAK.dexEntry: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.

HITMONLEE.name: Hitmonlee
HITMONLEE.dexEntry: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

HITMONCHAN.name: Hitmonchan
HITMONCHAN.dexEntry: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

LICKITUNG.name: Lickitung
LICKITUNG.dexEntry: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

KOFFING.name: Koffing
KOFFING.dexEntry: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

WEEZING.name: Weezing
WEEZING.dexEntry: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.

RHYHORN.name: Rhyhorn
RHYHORN.dexEntry: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.

RHYDON.name: Rhydon
RHYDON.dexEntry: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

CHANSEY.name: Chansey
CHANSEY.dexEntry: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

TANGELA.name: Tangela
TANGELA.dexEntry: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON's identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.

KANGASKHAN.name: Kangaskhan
KANGASKHAN.dexEntry: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.

HORSEA.name: Horsea
HORSEA.dexEntry: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

SEADRA.name: Seadra
SEADRA.dexEntry: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

GOLDEEN.name: Goldeen
GOLDEEN.dexEntry: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

SEAKING.name: Seaking
SEAKING.dexEntry: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.

STARYU.name: Staryu
STARYU.dexEntry: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

STARMIE.name: Starmie
STARMIE.dexEntry: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

MR_MIME.name: Mr. Mime
MR_MIME.dexEntry: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

SCYTHER.name: Scyther
SCYTHER.dexEntry: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

JYNX.name: Jynx
JYNX.dexEntry: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.

ELECTABUZZ.name: Electabuzz
ELECTABUZZ.dexEntry: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

MAGMAR.name: Magmar
MAGMAR.dexEntry: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

PINSIR.name: Pinsir
PINSIR.dexEntry: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won't release until the foe is torn.

TAUROS.name: Tauros
TAUROS.dexEntry: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.

MAGIKARP.name: Magikarp
MAGIKARP.dexEntry: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.

GYARADOS.name: Gyarados
GYARADOS.dexEntry: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

LAPRAS.name: Lapras
LAPRAS.dexEntry: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

DITTO.name: Ditto
DITTO.dexEntry: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.

EEVEE.name: Eevee
EEVEE.dexEntry: An extremely rare POKéMON that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.

VAPOREON.name: Vaporeon
VAPOREON.dexEntry: Its body's cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.

JOLTEON.name: Jolteon
JOLTEON.dexEntry: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

FLAREON.name: Flareon
FLAREON.dexEntry: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

PORYGON.name: Porygon
PORYGON.dexEntry: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial POKéMON.

OMANYTE.name: Omanyte
OMANYTE.dexEntry: A prehistoric POKéMON that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.

OMASTAR.name: Omastar
OMASTAR.dexEntry: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.

KABUTO.name: Kabuto
KABUTO.dexEntry: This POKéMON was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

KABUTOPS.name: Kabutops
KABUTOPS.dexEntry: It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim's fluids.

AERODACTYL.name: Aerodactyl
AERODACTYL.dexEntry: It was regenerated from a dinosaur's genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

SNORLAX.name: Snorlax
SNORLAX.dexEntry: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

ARTICUNO.name: Articuno
ARTICUNO.dexEntry: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.

ZAPDOS.name: Zapdos
ZAPDOS.dexEntry: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.

MOLTRES.name: Moltres
MOLTRES.dexEntry: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its orange wings that seem to be on fire.

DRATINI.name: Dratini
DRATINI.dexEntry: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.

DRAGONAIR.name: Dragonair
DRAGONAIR.dexEntry: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.

DRAGONITE.name: Dragonite
DRAGONITE.dexEntry: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

MEWTWO.name: Mewtwo
MEWTWO.dexEntry: A POKéMON whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

MEW.name: Mew
MEW.dexEntry: A POKéMON of South America that was thought to have been extinct. It is very intelligent and learns any move.

CHIKORITA.name: Chikorita
CHIKORITA.dexEntry: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

BAYLEEF.name: Bayleef
BAYLEEF.dexEntry: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

MEGANIUM.name: Meganium
MEGANIUM.dexEntry: MEGANIUM's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

CYNDAQUIL.name: Cyndaquil
CYNDAQUIL.dexEntry: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

QUILAVA.name: Quilava
QUILAVA.dexEntry: This POKéMON is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

TYPHLOSION.name: Typhlosion
TYPHLOSION.dexEntry: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

TOTODILE.name: Totodile
TOTODILE.dexEntry: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

CROCONAW.name: Croconaw
CROCONAW.dexEntry: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

FERALIGATR.name: Feraligatr
FERALIGATR.dexEntry: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

SENTRET.name: Sentret
SENTRET.dexEntry: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

FURRET.name: Furret
FURRET.dexEntry: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.

HOOTHOOT.name: Hoothoot
HOOTHOOT.dexEntry: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

NOCTOWL.name: Noctowl
NOCTOWL.dexEntry: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

LEDYBA.name: Ledyba
LEDYBA.dexEntry: When the weather turns cold, numerous LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

LEDIAN.name: Ledian
LEDIAN.dexEntry: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

SPINARAK.name: Spinarak
SPINARAK.dexEntry: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

ARIADOS.name: Ariados
ARIADOS.dexEntry: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

CROBAT.name: Crobat
CROBAT.dexEntry: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

CHINCHOU.name: Chinchou
CHINCHOU.dexEntry: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

LANTURN.name: Lanturn
LANTURN.dexEntry: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

PICHU.name: Pichu
PICHU.dexEntry: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

CLEFFA.name: Cleffa
CLEFFA.dexEntry: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.

IGGLYBUFF.name: Igglybuff
IGGLYBUFF.dexEntry: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.

TOGEPI.name: Togepi
TOGEPI.dexEntry: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.

TOGETIC.name: Togetic
TOGETIC.dexEntry: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

NATU.name: Natu
NATU.dexEntry: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

XATU.name: Xatu
XATU.dexEntry: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

MAREEP.name: Mareep
MAREEP.dexEntry: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

FLAAFFY.name: Flaaffy
FLAAFFY.dexEntry: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

AMPHAROS.name: Ampharos
AMPHAROS.dexEntry: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

BELLOSSOM.name: Bellossom
BELLOSSOM.dexEntry: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

MARILL.name: Marill
MARILL.dexEntry: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

AZUMARILL.name: Azumarill
AZUMARILL.dexEntry: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

SUDOWOODO.name: Sudowoodo
SUDOWOODO.dexEntry: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

POLITOED.name: Politoed
POLITOED.dexEntry: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

HOPPIP.name: Hoppip
HOPPIP.dexEntry: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

SKIPLOOM.name: Skiploom
SKIPLOOM.dexEntry: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

JUMPLUFF.name: Jumpluff
JUMPLUFF.dexEntry: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

AIPOM.name: Aipom
AIPOM.dexEntry: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

SUNKERN.name: Sunkern
SUNKERN.dexEntry: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

SUNFLORA.name: Sunflora
SUNFLORA.dexEntry: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

YANMA.name: Yanma
YANMA.dexEntry: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

WOOPER.name: Wooper
WOOPER.dexEntry: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

QUAGSIRE.name: Quagsire
QUAGSIRE.dexEntry: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

ESPEON.name: Espeon
ESPEON.dexEntry: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe's next move.

UMBREON.name: Umbreon
UMBREON.dexEntry: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

MURKROW.name: Murkrow
MURKROW.dexEntry: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

SLOWKING.name: Slowking
SLOWKING.dexEntry: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

MISDREAVUS.name: Misdreavus
MISDREAVUS.dexEntry: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

UNOWN.name: Unown
UNOWN.dexEntry: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

WOBBUFFET.name: Wobbuffet
WOBBUFFET.dexEntry: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

GIRAFARIG.name: Girafarig
GIRAFARIG.dexEntry: Its tail, which also contains a small brain, may bite on its own if it notices an alluring smell.

PINECO.name: Pineco
PINECO.dexEntry: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

FORRETRESS.name: Forretress
FORRETRESS.dexEntry: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

DUNSPARCE.name: Dunsparce
DUNSPARCE.dexEntry: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can hover just slightly using its wings.

GLIGAR.name: Gligar
GLIGAR.dexEntry: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

STEELIX.name: Steelix
STEELIX.dexEntry: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

SNUBBULL.name: Snubbull
SNUBBULL.dexEntry: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

GRANBULL.name: Granbull
GRANBULL.dexEntry: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its BITE is powerful.

QWILFISH.name: Qwilfish
QWILFISH.dexEntry: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.

SCIZOR.name: Scizor
SCIZOR.dexEntry: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

SHUCKLE.name: Shuckle
SHUCKLE.dexEntry: It stores BERRIES inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

HERACROSS.name: Heracross
HERACROSS.dexEntry: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

SNEASEL.name: Sneasel
SNEASEL.dexEntry: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.

TEDDIURSA.name: Teddiursa
TEDDIURSA.dexEntry: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

URSARING.name: Ursaring
URSARING.dexEntry: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

SLUGMA.name: Slugma
SLUGMA.dexEntry: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

MAGCARGO.name: Magcargo
MAGCARGO.dexEntry: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

SWINUB.name: Swinub
SWINUB.dexEntry: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

PILOSWINE.name: Piloswine
PILOSWINE.dexEntry: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

CORSOLA.name: Corsola
CORSOLA.dexEntry: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these POKéMON.

REMORAID.name: Remoraid
REMORAID.dexEntry: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a MANTINE's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

OCTILLERY.name: Octillery
OCTILLERY.dexEntry: It instinctively sneaks into rocky holes. If it gets sleepy, it steals the nest of a fellow OCTILLERY.

DELIBIRD.name: Delibird
DELIBIRD.dexEntry: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

MANTINE.name: Mantine
MANTINE.dexEntry: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

SKARMORY.name: Skarmory
SKARMORY.dexEntry: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

HOUNDOUR.name: Houndour
HOUNDOUR.dexEntry: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

HOUNDOOM.name: Houndoom
HOUNDOOM.dexEntry: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

KINGDRA.name: Kingdra
KINGDRA.dexEntry: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

PHANPY.name: Phanpy
PHANPY.dexEntry: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

DONPHAN.name: Donphan
DONPHAN.dexEntry: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

PORYGON2.name: Porygon2
PORYGON2.dexEntry: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

STANTLER.name: Stantler
STANTLER.dexEntry: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.

SMEARGLE.name: Smeargle
SMEARGLE.dexEntry: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

TYROGUE.name: Tyrogue
TYROGUE.dexEntry: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

HITMONTOP.name: Hitmontop
HITMONTOP.dexEntry: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

SMOOCHUM.name: Smoochum
SMOOCHUM.dexEntry: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

ELEKID.name: Elekid
ELEKID.dexEntry: Even in the most vicious storm, this POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

MAGBY.name: Magby
MAGBY.dexEntry: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

MILTANK.name: Miltank
MILTANK.dexEntry: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

BLISSEY.name: Blissey
BLISSEY.dexEntry: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

RAIKOU.name: Raikou
RAIKOU.dexEntry: This POKéMON races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

ENTEI.name: Entei
ENTEI.dexEntry: A POKéMON that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

SUICUNE.name: Suicune
SUICUNE.dexEntry: This POKéMON races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

LARVITAR.name: Larvitar
LARVITAR.dexEntry: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

PUPITAR.name: Pupitar
PUPITAR.dexEntry: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

TYRANITAR.name: Tyranitar
TYRANITAR.dexEntry: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.It has an impudent nature. Having great strength, it can even change surrounding landforms.

LUGIA.name: Lugia
LUGIA.dexEntry: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

HO_OH.name: Ho-Oh
HO_OH.dexEntry: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

CELEBI.name: Celebi
CELEBI.dexEntry: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

TREECKO.name: Treecko
TREECKO.dexEntry: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.

GROVYLE.name: Grovyle
GROVYLE.dexEntry: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

SCEPTILE.name: Sceptile
SCEPTILE.dexEntry: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

TORCHIC.name: Torchic
TORCHIC.dexEntry: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

COMBUSKEN.name: Combusken
COMBUSKEN.dexEntry: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

BLAZIKEN.name: Blaziken
BLAZIKEN.dexEntry: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

MUDKIP.name: Mudkip
MUDKIP.dexEntry: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.

MARSHTOMP.name: Marshtomp
MARSHTOMP.dexEntry: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.

SWAMPERT.name: Swampert
SWAMPERT.dexEntry: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

POOCHYENA.name: Poochyena
POOCHYENA.dexEntry: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

MIGHTYENA.name: Mightyena
MIGHTYENA.dexEntry: It will always obey the commands of a skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

ZIGZAGOON.name: Zigzagoon
ZIGZAGOON.dexEntry: A POKéMON with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.

LINOONE.name: Linoone
LINOONE.dexEntry: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.

WURMPLE.name: Wurmple
WURMPLE.dexEntry: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.

SILCOON.name: Silcoon
SILCOON.dexEntry: It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.

BEAUTIFLY.name: Beautifly
BEAUTIFLY.dexEntry: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.

CASCOON.name: Cascoon
CASCOON.dexEntry: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

DUSTOX.name: Dustox
DUSTOX.dexEntry: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.

LOTAD.name: Lotad
LOTAD.dexEntry: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

LOMBRE.name: Lombre
LOMBRE.dexEntry: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

LUDICOLO.name: Ludicolo
LUDICOLO.dexEntry: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates LUDICOLO's cells, making it more powerful.

SEEDOT.name: Seedot
SEEDOT.dexEntry: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging PIDGEY.

NUZLEAF.name: Nuzleaf
NUZLEAF.dexEntry: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of NUZLEAF's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

SHIFTRY.name: Shiftry
SHIFTRY.dexEntry: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

TAILLOW.name: Taillow
TAILLOW.dexEntry: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

SWELLOW.name: Swellow
SWELLOW.dexEntry: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

WINGULL.name: Wingull
WINGULL.dexEntry: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

PELIPPER.name: Pelipper
PELIPPER.dexEntry: It is a flying transporter that carries small POKéMON in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

RALTS.name: Ralts
RALTS.dexEntry: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and POKéMON. It hides if it senses hostility.

KIRLIA.name: Kirlia
KIRLIA.dexEntry: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

GARDEVOIR.name: Gardevoir
GARDEVOIR.dexEntry: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.

SURSKIT.name: Surskit
SURSKIT.dexEntry: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

MASQUERAIN.name: Masquerain
MASQUERAIN.dexEntry: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

SHROOMISH.name: Shroomish
SHROOMISH.dexEntry: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

BRELOOM.name: Breloom
BRELOOM.dexEntry: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

SLAKOTH.name: Slakoth
SLAKOTH.dexEntry: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

VIGOROTH.name: Vigoroth
VIGOROTH.dexEntry: It is always hungry because it won't stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can't keep still.

SLAKING.name: Slaking
SLAKING.dexEntry: It is the world's most slothful POKéMON. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

NINCADA.name: Nincada
NINCADA.dexEntry: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

NINJASK.name: Ninjask
NINJASK.dexEntry: This POKéMON is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

SHEDINJA.name: Shedinja
SHEDINJA.dexEntry: A most peculiar POKéMON that somehow appears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA evolves.

WHISMUR.name: Whismur
WHISMUR.dexEntry: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

LOUDRED.name: Loudred
LOUDRED.dexEntry: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.

EXPLOUD.name: Exploud
EXPLOUD.dexEntry: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.

MAKUHITA.name: Makuhita
MAKUHITA.dexEntry: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy POKéMON that can withstand any attack.

HARIYAMA.name: Hariyama
HARIYAMA.dexEntry: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

AZURILL.name: Azurill
AZURILL.dexEntry: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.

NOSEPASS.name: Nosepass
NOSEPASS.dexEntry: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get their bearings.

SKITTY.name: Skitty
SKITTY.dexEntry: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.

DELCATTY.name: Delcatty
DELCATTY.dexEntry: The favorite of trend-conscious female TRAINERS, they are used in competition for their style and fur.

SABLEYE.name: Sableye
SABLEYE.dexEntry: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

MAWILE.name: Mawile
MAWILE.dexEntry: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

ARON.name: Aron
ARON.dexEntry: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.

LAIRON.name: Lairon
LAIRON.dexEntry: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

AGGRON.name: Aggron
AGGRON.dexEntry: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.

MEDITITE.name: Meditite
MEDITITE.dexEntry: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

MEDICHAM.name: Medicham
MEDICHAM.dexEntry: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

ELECTRIKE.name: Electrike
ELECTRIKE.dexEntry: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

MANECTRIC.name: Manectric
MANECTRIC.dexEntry: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

PLUSLE.name: Plusle
PLUSLE.dexEntry: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

MINUN.name: Minun
MINUN.dexEntry: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

VOLBEAT.name: Volbeat
VOLBEAT.dexEntry: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

ILLUMISE.name: Illumise
ILLUMISE.dexEntry: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.

ROSELIA.name: Roselia
ROSELIA.dexEntry: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the ROSELIA is.

GULPIN.name: Gulpin
GULPIN.dexEntry: There is nothing its stomach can't digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

SWALOT.name: Swalot
SWALOT.dexEntry: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

CARVANHA.name: Carvanha
CARVANHA.dexEntry: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

SHARPEDO.name: Sharpedo
SHARPEDO.dexEntry: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

WAILMER.name: Wailmer
WAILMER.dexEntry: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

WAILORD.name: Wailord
WAILORD.dexEntry: It is among the largest of all POKéMON. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.

NUMEL.name: Numel
NUMEL.dexEntry: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

CAMERUPT.name: Camerupt
CAMERUPT.dexEntry: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

TORKOAL.name: Torkoal
TORKOAL.dexEntry: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.

SPOINK.name: Spoink
SPOINK.dexEntry: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.

GRUMPIG.name: Grumpig
GRUMPIG.dexEntry: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.

SPINDA.name: Spinda
SPINDA.dexEntry: No two SPINDA are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.

TRAPINCH.name: Trapinch
TRAPINCH.dexEntry: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

VIBRAVA.name: Vibrava
VIBRAVA.dexEntry: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

FLYGON.name: Flygon
FLYGON.dexEntry: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

CACNEA.name: Cacnea
CACNEA.dexEntry: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

CACTURNE.name: Cacturne
CACTURNE.dexEntry: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert's heat.

SWABLU.name: Swablu
SWABLU.dexEntry: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

ALTARIA.name: Altaria
ALTARIA.dexEntry: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA's humming.

ZANGOOSE.name: Zangoose
ZANGOOSE.dexEntry: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.

SEVIPER.name: Seviper
SEVIPER.dexEntry: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

LUNATONE.name: Lunatone
LUNATONE.dexEntry: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.

SOLROCK.name: Solrock
SOLROCK.dexEntry: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

BARBOACH.name: Barboach
BARBOACH.dexEntry: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

WHISCASH.name: Whiscash
WHISCASH.dexEntry: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, WHISCASH will eat it.

CORPHISH.name: Corphish
CORPHISH.dexEntry: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

CRAWDAUNT.name: Crawdaunt
CRAWDAUNT.dexEntry: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

BALTOY.name: Baltoy
BALTOY.dexEntry: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

CLAYDOL.name: Claydol
CLAYDOL.dexEntry: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

LILEEP.name: Lileep
LILEEP.dexEntry: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.

CRADILY.name: Cradily
CRADILY.dexEntry: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

ANORITH.name: Anorith
ANORITH.dexEntry: It is a kind of POKéMON progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

ARMALDO.name: Armaldo
ARMALDO.dexEntry: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

FEEBAS.name: Feebas
FEEBAS.dexEntry: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.

MILOTIC.name: Milotic
MILOTIC.dexEntry: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

CASTFORM.name: Castform
CASTFORM.dexEntry: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.

KECLEON.name: Kecleon
KECLEON.dexEntry: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.

SHUPPET.name: Shuppet
SHUPPET.dexEntry: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

BANETTE.name: Banette
BANETTE.dexEntry: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a POKéMON. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

DUSKULL.name: Duskull
DUSKULL.dexEntry: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

DUSCLOPS.name: Dusclops
DUSCLOPS.dexEntry: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

TROPIUS.name: Tropius
TROPIUS.dexEntry: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

CHIMECHO.name: Chimecho
CHIMECHO.dexEntry: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly uses its long tail to pluck nuts and berries, which it loves to eat.

ABSOL.name: Absol
ABSOL.dexEntry: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

WYNAUT.name: Wynaut
WYNAUT.dexEntry: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

SNORUNT.name: Snorunt
SNORUNT.dexEntry: It is said that a home visited by a SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

GLALIE.name: Glalie
GLALIE.dexEntry: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

SPHEAL.name: Spheal
SPHEAL.dexEntry: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

SEALEO.name: Sealeo
SEALEO.dexEntry: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning SPHEAL on its nose.

WALREIN.name: Walrein
WALREIN.dexEntry: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

CLAMPERL.name: Clamperl
CLAMPERL.dexEntry: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

HUNTAIL.name: Huntail
HUNTAIL.dexEntry: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.

GOREBYSS.name: Gorebyss
GOREBYSS.dexEntry: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

RELICANTH.name: Relicanth
RELICANTH.dexEntry: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.

LUVDISC.name: Luvdisc
LUVDISC.dexEntry: During the spawning season, countless LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

BAGON.name: Bagon
BAGON.dexEntry: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

SHELGON.name: Shelgon
SHELGON.dexEntry: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

SALAMENCE.name: Salamence
SALAMENCE.dexEntry: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

BELDUM.name: Beldum
BELDUM.dexEntry: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.

METANG.name: Metang
METANG.dexEntry: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won't leave a scratch.

METAGROSS.name: Metagross
METAGROSS.dexEntry: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

REGIROCK.name: Regirock
REGIROCK.dexEntry: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.

REGICE.name: Regice
REGICE.dexEntry: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.

REGISTEEL.name: Registeel
REGISTEEL.dexEntry: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.

LATIAS.name: Latias
LATIAS.dexEntry: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

LATIOS.name: Latios
LATIOS.dexEntry: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.

KYOGRE.name: Kyogre
KYOGRE.dexEntry: This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

GROUDON.name: Groudon
GROUDON.dexEntry: This legendary POKéMON is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.

RAYQUAZA.name: Rayquaza
RAYQUAZA.dexEntry: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

JIRACHI.name: Jirachi
JIRACHI.dexEntry: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.

DEOXYS.name: Deoxys
DEOXYS.dexEntry: This DEOXYS has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.
